classification.difficultyReason: Combines special-quadrilateral properties, parallel-line angle relationships and the quadrilateral angle sum.

content.prompt: Work out the values of the letters in these diagrams.

spec.description: Unshaded trapezium with a shorter horizontal upper base, matching single parallel arrows and all four interior angle arcs.
spec.mathematics: Upper and lower bases are parallel. Bottom angles are 48° and 68°; upper angles are b and a respectively.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels are visible.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles on parallel lines sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}a+68^\circ&=180^\circ\\a&=112^\circ\\b+48^\circ&=180^\circ\\b&=132^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Vertical kite with single equality ticks on its upper pair of sides, double ticks on its lower pair, and four interior angle arcs.
spec.mathematics: Top angle 46°, left angle 125°, right angle x and bottom angle y. The marked side pairs establish a kite.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels are visible.

answer.worked:
The opposite angles between the unequal sides of a kite are equal, so $x=125^\circ$.
Using the angle sum of a quadrilateral:
$$\begin{align*}y+46^\circ+125^\circ+125^\circ&=360^\circ\\y+296^\circ&=360^\circ\\y&=64^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Parallelogram sloping down to the right, with single parallel arrows on horizontal sides, double arrows on sloping sides, extended lower and left sides, and interior and exterior angle arcs.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles p at bottom left, q at top left, r at top right and s at bottom right. The exterior angle vertically opposite p is 112°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels are visible.

answer.worked:
Vertically opposite angles are equal, so $p=112^\circ$.
Co-interior angles on parallel lines sum to $180^\circ$:
$$\begin{align*}q+112^\circ&=180^\circ\\q&=68^\circ\end{align*}$$
Opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal:
$$\begin{align*}r&=p=112^\circ\\s&=q=68^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Isosceles trapezium with a longer vertical left side and shorter vertical right side, matching single parallel arrows, matching single ticks on its sloping sides and all four angle arcs.
spec.mathematics: Angles l at top left, m at bottom left, n at bottom right and 105° at top right. The nonparallel sides are equal.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels are visible.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles on the parallel sides sum to $180^\circ$:
$$\begin{align*}l+105^\circ&=180^\circ\\l&=75^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles at each parallel base of an isosceles trapezium are equal:
$$\begin{align*}m&=l=75^\circ\\n&=105^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Parallelogram with sides rising to the right, double parallel arrows on its horizontal sides, single arrows on its sloping sides and an extended right side above the upper-right vertex.
spec.mathematics: Lower interior angles h and g. The exterior angle between the upper side and the extended right side is 115°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels are visible.

answer.worked:
Corresponding angles on the parallel horizontal sides are equal, so $g=115^\circ$.
Adjacent angles of a parallelogram sum to $180^\circ$:
$$\begin{align*}h+115^\circ&=180^\circ\\h&=65^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Quadrilateral with parallel horizontal bases, a vertical left side, a longer upper base, upper-left right-angle square and extended lower base to the right.
spec.mathematics: Bottom-left angle e, top-right angle f and bottom-right exterior angle 57°. Both horizontal bases carry matching single parallel arrows.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels are visible.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles on the parallel bases sum to $180^\circ$:
$$\begin{align*}e+90^\circ&=180^\circ\\e&=90^\circ\end{align*}$$
Alternate angles on the parallel bases are equal, so $f=57^\circ$.
